```{r setup, include=FALSE}

library(here)

source(here("Ghasemi_analysis", "R", "setup.R"))
source(here("Ghasemi_analysis", "R", "functions.R"))

library(Seurat)
library(harmony)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

seed_value <- 20200204
ndim       <- 20   # Harmony dims (same as 05)
ndim_single <- 10  # PCA dims for single-sample clustering (same as 01)

out_dir <- here("Ghasemi_analysis", "results", "cluster_stability_forced_k")
dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

```

## Overview

Mirrors reference Aim 1.1 (n = 1) and Aim 1.2 (n = 2 ... 9).

* **Reference clustering** = the 9-sample integrated clustering already saved by 05
  (`9_cluster_results.rds`, res 0.175). It plays the role of the published annotation.
* For every n < 9, samples are added cumulatively in order of malignant cell count.
  The *resolution is tuned so the number of clusters equals the reference k*.
* Heatmap: x = reference cluster, y = new cluster. Fill = relative fraction, i.e. the
  fraction of each reference cluster's cells that land in each new cluster
  (every column sums to 1). Tile text = cell counts.
* Nothing here overwrites `combined.rds`. Each n is cached as its own small `.rds`
  in `cluster_stability_forced_k/` (delete a file to force a rerun).

## Helper functions

```{r functions}

# ---- level ordering: numeric if labels look numeric, otherwise alphabetical ----
ord_levels <- function(x) {
  u <- unique(as.character(x))
  n <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(u))
  if (anyNA(n)) sort(u) else u[order(n)]
}

# ---- find the resolution that gives exactly `target_k` clusters ----
# Runs one FindClusters call over a grid of resolutions (graph is built once),
# counts clusters at each, and picks the middle of the resolutions that hit
# target_k (more robust than the first hit). If none hit exactly, uses the
# closest k and warns. FindNeighbors() must already have been run.
find_resolution_for_k <- function(sobj, target_k,
                                  res_grid = round(seq(0.02, 1.5, by = 0.01), 3),
                                  seed = seed_value) {

  # drop old *_snn_res.* columns so only the new grid is counted
  md <- sobj@meta.data
  sobj@meta.data <- md[, !grepl("_snn_res\\.", colnames(md)), drop = FALSE]

  sobj <- FindClusters(sobj, resolution = res_grid,
                       random.seed = seed, verbose = FALSE)

  cols <- grep("_snn_res\\.", colnames(sobj@meta.data), value = TRUE)
  res  <- as.numeric(sub(".*_res\\.", "", cols))
  ks   <- vapply(cols, function(cl) length(unique(sobj[[cl]][, 1])), integer(1))

  hit <- res[ks == target_k]
  if (length(hit) > 0) {
    best <- hit[which.min(abs(hit - median(hit)))]
  } else {
    best <- res[which.min(abs(ks - target_k))]
    warning("No resolution gave exactly k = ", target_k,
            "; using res = ", best, " (k = ", ks[res == best][1], ")")
  }

  best_col <- cols[which(res == best)[1]]
  labels <- as.character(sobj[[best_col]][, 1])
  names(labels) <- colnames(sobj)

  list(resolution = best, k = length(unique(labels)), clusters = labels)
}

# ---- package a fitted object into a small, savable list ----
finish_fit <- function(sobj, fit, reduction_umap = "umap") {
  um <- as.data.frame(Embeddings(sobj, reduction_umap))
  colnames(um) <- c("UMAP_1", "UMAP_2")
  um$cell <- rownames(um)

  list(
    assign = data.frame(
      cell    = colnames(sobj),
      sample  = as.character(sobj$sample),
      cluster = fit$clusters[colnames(sobj)],
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ),
    umap = um,
    resolution = fit$resolution,
    k = fit$k
  )
}

# ---- n >= 2: same steps as runIntegration() in 05, but no file saving and forced k ----
integrate_subset <- function(base, samples, target_k,
                             ndim = 20, theta = 2, seed = seed_value) {

  sobj <- subset(base, subset = sample %in% samples)

  sobj <- NormalizeData(sobj, normalization.method = "LogNormalize",
                        scale.factor = 10000, verbose = FALSE)
  sobj <- FindVariableFeatures(sobj, selection.method = "vst",
                               nfeatures = 3000, verbose = FALSE)
  sobj <- ScaleData(sobj, vars.to.regress = c("nCount_RNA", "percent.mt"),
                    verbose = FALSE)
  sobj <- RunPCA(sobj, features = VariableFeatures(sobj), verbose = FALSE)

  set.seed(seed)
  sobj <- RunHarmony(sobj, group.by.vars = "sample", theta = theta)

  sobj <- FindNeighbors(sobj, reduction = "harmony", dims = 1:ndim,
                        verbose = FALSE)
  fit  <- find_resolution_for_k(sobj, target_k, seed = seed)

  sobj <- RunUMAP(sobj, reduction = "harmony", dims = 1:ndim,
                  seed.use = seed, verbose = FALSE)

  finish_fit(sobj, fit)
}

# ---- n = 1: cluster one sample on its own (malignant cells only), forced k ----
# Analogue of reference Aim 1.1, which re-ran the pipeline per patient on the
# subset of cells that had annotations.
single_sample_fit <- function(sid, ref_assign, target_k,
                              ndim_single = 10, seed = seed_value) {

  f <- list.files(here("Ghasemi_analysis", "results", "sample_results"),
                  pattern = "_object_with_SingleR\\.rds$",
                  recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE)
  f <- f[startsWith(basename(f), paste0(sid, "_"))]
  stopifnot("expected exactly one per-sample object" = length(f) == 1)

  obj   <- readRDS(f)
  ref_s <- ref_assign[ref_assign$sample == sid, ]

  # Match cells by name after stripping a trailing "_<digits>" suffix (e.g. the
  # "_1" that merge() appended in 05: MBEN_AK1_c3_1 -> MBEN_AK1_c3). Per-sample
  # names end in "_c<digits>", so they are left unchanged. Matching is within a
  # single sample, so there is no cross-sample collision risk.
  core_bc <- function(x) sub("_[0-9]+$", "", x)
  obj_key <- core_bc(colnames(obj))
  ref_key <- core_bc(ref_s$cell)
  dup_examples <- function(k, nm) {
    d <- k %in% k[duplicated(k)]
    if (any(d)) paste(head(nm[d], 8), collapse = ", ") else "none"
  }
  d_obj <- dup_examples(obj_key, colnames(obj))
  d_ref <- dup_examples(ref_key, ref_s$cell)
  if (d_obj != "none" || d_ref != "none") {
    stop(sid, ": duplicate names after stripping the suffix.",
         "\n  per-sample object: ", d_obj,
         "\n  reference:         ", d_ref)
  }

  keep <- obj_key %in% ref_key
  message(sid, ": ", sum(keep), " of ", nrow(ref_s),
          " reference cells found in per-sample object")
  if (sum(keep) == 0) {
    stop(sid, ": no barcode overlap.\n  per-sample: ",
         paste(head(colnames(obj), 3), collapse = ", "),
         "\n  reference:  ", paste(head(ref_s$cell, 3), collapse = ", "))
  }
  if (sum(keep) < 0.9 * nrow(ref_s)) {
    warning(sid, ": fewer than 90% of reference cells were found.")
  }

  obj <- subset(obj, cells = colnames(obj)[keep])
  # rename to the reference's cell names so later joins by cell name work
  obj <- RenameCells(obj, new.names = ref_s$cell[match(core_bc(colnames(obj)), ref_key)])
  obj$sample <- sid
  DefaultAssay(obj) <- "RNA"

  obj <- NormalizeData(obj, verbose = FALSE)
  obj <- FindVariableFeatures(obj, selection.method = "vst",
                              nfeatures = 3000, verbose = FALSE)
  obj <- ScaleData(obj, verbose = FALSE)

  npcs <- min(30, ncol(obj) - 1)
  obj  <- RunPCA(obj, features = VariableFeatures(obj), npcs = npcs,
                 verbose = FALSE)
  dims <- 1:min(ndim_single, npcs)

  obj <- FindNeighbors(obj, reduction = "pca", dims = dims, verbose = FALSE)
  fit <- find_resolution_for_k(obj, target_k, seed = seed)
  obj <- RunUMAP(obj, reduction = "pca", dims = dims,
                 seed.use = seed, verbose = FALSE)

  finish_fit(obj, fit)
}

# ---- overlap table: rows = new clusters, cols = reference clusters ----
# frac is normalised per reference cluster (columns sum to 1).
# Rows are ordered by best-matching reference cluster, so a stable clustering
# shows up as a diagonal. (Cluster numbers are arbitrary between runs.)
overlap_table <- function(ref_cluster, new_cluster) {
  tab <- table(
    new = factor(as.character(new_cluster), levels = ord_levels(new_cluster)),
    ref = factor(as.character(ref_cluster), levels = ord_levels(ref_cluster))
  )
  m    <- unclass(tab)
  frac <- sweep(m, 2, pmax(colSums(m), 1), "/")

  best_ref <- apply(frac, 1, which.max)
  best_val <- apply(frac, 1, max)
  ord <- order(best_ref, -best_val)

  list(counts = m[ord, , drop = FALSE], frac = frac[ord, , drop = FALSE])
}

overlap_heatmap <- function(ref_cluster, new_cluster, xlab, ylab) {
  ot <- overlap_table(ref_cluster, new_cluster)

  if (nrow(ot$counts) == 0 || ncol(ot$counts) == 0) {
    stop("Empty overlap table: no cells to compare.")
  }

  # long format, built by hand (column-major, same order as as.vector())
  df <- data.frame(
    new   = rep(rownames(ot$counts), times = ncol(ot$counts)),
    ref   = rep(colnames(ot$counts), each  = nrow(ot$counts)),
    count = as.vector(ot$counts),
    frac  = as.vector(ot$frac),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  df$ref  <- factor(df$ref, levels = colnames(ot$counts))
  df$new  <- factor(df$new, levels = rev(rownames(ot$counts)))  # first row on top

  ggplot(df, aes(x = ref, y = new, fill = frac)) +
    geom_tile(width = 0.9, height = 0.9) +
    geom_text(aes(label = count, color = frac > 0.5),
              fontface = "bold", size = 5, show.legend = FALSE) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "white", "FALSE" = "black")) +
    scale_fill_gradient(
      low = "white", high = "forestgreen", limits = c(0, 1),
      name = "Relative fraction\n(of reference cluster)",
      guide = guide_colorbar(title.position = "top", title.hjust = 0.5)
    ) +
    labs(x = xlab, y = ylab) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
          axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
          axis.text.y = element_text(face = "bold"),
          legend.position = "right") +
    coord_fixed(ratio = 1)
}

umap_panel <- function(fit) {
  df <- merge(fit$umap, fit$assign[, c("cell", "cluster")], by = "cell")
  df$cluster <- factor(df$cluster, levels = ord_levels(df$cluster))
  cent <- aggregate(cbind(UMAP_1, UMAP_2) ~ cluster, data = df, FUN = median)

  ggplot(df, aes(x = UMAP_1, y = UMAP_2, color = cluster)) +
    geom_point(size = 0.4) +
    geom_text(data = cent, aes(x = UMAP_1, y = UMAP_2, label = cluster),
              inherit.aes = FALSE, color = "black", fontface = "bold", size = 5) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
    theme(legend.position = "none") +
    coord_fixed()
}

make_panel <- function(fit, title, ref_assign, xlab, ylab) {
  a <- fit$assign
  r <- ref_assign$cluster[match(a$cell, ref_assign$cell)]
  keep <- !is.na(r)

  if (sum(keep) == 0) {
    stop("None of this fit's cells match the reference cell names.\n  fit:       ",
         paste(head(a$cell, 3), collapse = ", "),
         "\n  reference: ", paste(head(ref_assign$cell, 3), collapse = ", "),
         "\n  If these differ, the fit was probably cached from an earlier run. ",
         "Delete the .rds files in cluster_stability_forced_k/ and rerun.")
  }
  message(title, ": ", sum(keep), " of ", nrow(a), " cells matched the reference")

  p_h <- overlap_heatmap(r[keep], a$cluster[keep], xlab, ylab)
  p_u <- umap_panel(fit)

  (p_u | p_h) +
    plot_annotation(
      title = title,
      theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 16))
    )
}

# ---- Adjusted Rand Index (no extra dependency) ----
ari <- function(a, b) {
  tab <- table(a, b)
  c2  <- function(x) x * (x - 1) / 2
  sum_ij <- sum(c2(tab))
  sum_a  <- sum(c2(rowSums(tab)))
  sum_b  <- sum(c2(colSums(tab)))
  expected <- sum_a * sum_b / c2(sum(tab))
  (sum_ij - expected) / (0.5 * (sum_a + sum_b) - expected)
}

summarise_fit <- function(fit, label, ref_assign) {
  a <- fit$assign
  r <- ref_assign$cluster[match(a$cell, ref_assign$cell)]
  ot <- overlap_table(r, a$cluster)
  present <- colSums(ot$counts) > 0

  data.frame(
    comparison = label,
    n_cells = nrow(a),
    resolution = fit$resolution,
    k_achieved = fit$k,
    ARI = ari(r, a$cluster),
    # mean over reference clusters of the largest fraction that lands in one new cluster
    mean_best_match = mean(apply(ot$frac[, present, drop = FALSE], 2, max))
  )
}

```

## Reference clustering and sample order

```{r reference}

ref <- readRDS(here("Ghasemi_analysis", "results", "cluster_stability",
                    "9_cluster_results.rds"))
ref_assign <- ref$cell_assignments
ref_assign$cluster <- as.character(ref_assign$cluster)
ref_assign$sample  <- as.character(ref_assign$sample)

k_ref <- length(unique(ref_assign$cluster))
message("Reference k = ", k_ref)
table(ref_assign$cluster)

# base object: malignant cells, before any re-integration (saved by 05)
base <- readRDS(here("Ghasemi_analysis", "results", "combined",
                     "malignant_base_before_reintegration.rds"))

# order samples by malignant cell count, largest first (as in the reference)
cell_counts  <- sort(table(as.character(base$sample)), decreasing = TRUE)
sample_order <- names(cell_counts)
print(cell_counts)

# compare with the order hard-coded in 05
old_order <- c("AK1", "MB295", "MB299", "MB287", "AK3", "MB266", "MB263", "MB88", "AK2")
if (!identical(sample_order, old_order)) {
  message("NOTE: cell-count order differs from the order hard-coded in 05:\n  new: ",
          paste(sample_order, collapse = ", "), "\n  old: ",
          paste(old_order, collapse = ", "))
}

```

## Cumulative integrations, n = 8 ... 2 (forced k)

The 9-sample result is reused as the reference and is not rerun.

```{r cumulative}

fits <- list()

for (n in 8:2) {

  res_file <- file.path(out_dir, paste0(n, "_forced_k_results.rds"))

  if (file.exists(res_file)) {
    message("n = ", n, ": loading cached result")
    fits[[as.character(n)]] <- readRDS(res_file)
    next
  }

  message("n = ", n, ": integrating ", paste(sample_order[1:n], collapse = ", "))
  fit <- integrate_subset(base, sample_order[1:n], target_k = k_ref, ndim = ndim)
  fit$n <- n
  fit$samples <- sample_order[1:n]

  saveRDS(fit, res_file)
  fits[[as.character(n)]] <- fit
}

```

## Single samples, n = 1 (forced k)

Each sample is re-clustered on its own malignant cells with k forced to the
reference k. Note that a single sample may not contain every reference cluster,
so forcing k can over-split it.

```{r single}

single_fits <- list()

for (sid in sample_order) {

  res_file <- file.path(out_dir, paste0("single_", sid, "_forced_k_results.rds"))

  if (file.exists(res_file)) {
    single_fits[[sid]] <- readRDS(res_file)
    next
  }

  message("Single sample: ", sid)
  fit <- single_sample_fit(sid, ref_assign, target_k = k_ref,
                           ndim_single = ndim_single)
  saveRDS(fit, res_file)
  single_fits[[sid]] <- fit
}

```

## Heatmaps

```{r heatmaps, fig.width=20, fig.height=9}

xlab <- "Reference cluster (9-sample integration)"

# cumulative n = 8 ... 2
for (n in 8:2) {
  fit <- fits[[as.character(n)]]

  p <- make_panel(
    fit,
    title = paste0("Top ", n, " samples: ", paste(sample_order[1:n], collapse = ", "),
                   "   (res = ", fit$resolution, ", k = ", fit$k, ")"),
    ref_assign = ref_assign,
    xlab = xlab,
    ylab = paste0("Cluster in ", n, "-sample integration")
  )

  ggsave(file.path(out_dir, paste0("overlap_9v", n, "_forced_k.png")),
         plot = p, width = 20, height = 9, bg = "white")
  print(p)
}

# single samples
for (sid in names(single_fits)) {
  fit <- single_fits[[sid]]

  p <- make_panel(
    fit,
    title = paste0("Sample ", sid, " alone",
                   "   (res = ", fit$resolution, ", k = ", fit$k, ")"),
    ref_assign = ref_assign,
    xlab = xlab,
    ylab = paste0("Cluster in ", sid, " alone")
  )

  ggsave(file.path(out_dir, paste0("overlap_9v_single_", sid, "_forced_k.png")),
         plot = p, width = 20, height = 9, bg = "white")
  print(p)
}

```

## Summary metrics

ARI compares the whole partition to the reference (1 = identical, ~0 = chance).
`mean_best_match` is the average, over reference clusters, of the largest
relative fraction that ends up in a single new cluster (1 = every reference
cluster stays intact). Single-sample rows are computed within that sample's
cells only, so compare them with each other rather than with the cumulative rows.

```{r summary}

summary_cumulative <- bind_rows(lapply(names(fits), function(n) {
  summarise_fit(fits[[n]], paste0("top", n), ref_assign)
}))
summary_cumulative$n_samples <- as.numeric(sub("top", "", summary_cumulative$comparison))
summary_cumulative <- summary_cumulative[order(summary_cumulative$n_samples), ]

summary_single <- bind_rows(lapply(names(single_fits), function(sid) {
  summarise_fit(single_fits[[sid]], paste0("single_", sid), ref_assign)
}))

summary_all <- bind_rows(summary_single, summary_cumulative[, names(summary_single)])
write.csv(summary_all, file.path(out_dir, "stability_summary.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
summary_all

p_sum <- ggplot(summary_cumulative, aes(x = n_samples)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = ARI, color = "ARI")) +
  geom_point(aes(y = ARI, color = "ARI"), size = 3) +
  geom_line(aes(y = mean_best_match, color = "Mean best-match fraction")) +
  geom_point(aes(y = mean_best_match, color = "Mean best-match fraction"), size = 3) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 2:8) +
  ylim(0, 1) +
  labs(x = "Number of samples integrated", y = "Agreement with 9-sample reference",
       color = NULL, title = "Cluster stability vs number of samples (forced k)") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"))

ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "stability_summary.png"), plot = p_sum,
       width = 9, height = 6, bg = "white")
p_sum

```
